claim: wrangler >=4.118.0 changed the default of `X_LOCAL_OBSERVABILITY`. In wrangler dev, X_LOCAL_OBSERVABILITY is now on out of the box; previously opt-in behind X_LOCAL_OBSERVABILITY=true. Silent: code written for older versions still runs, without an error.
wrangler >=4.121.0 changed what `DO_NOT_TRACK` does. Wrangler now disables telemetry when DO_NOT_TRACK=1 is set. Silent: code written for older versions still runs, without an error.

wrangler >=4.122.0 changed the default of `nodejs_compat`. As of compatibility date 2026-08-04, wrangler treats nodejs_compat as enabled by default; previously only when the flag was listed explicitly. Silent: code written for older versions still runs, without an error.
